title: Native image - java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: com.fasterxml.jackson.module.jaxb.JaxbAnnotationIntrospector
body:
Native image build process throws java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: com.fasterxml.jackson.module.jaxb.JaxbAnnotationIntrospector

Native image is generated, but console is polluted with stacktrace.
Running Quarkus master and GraalVM 19.0.2 CE.
